subject: Parking
description: In the Matter of Parking Offense Bail (Mar 5 2003)
issuer: Multnomah County Circuit Court — Presiding Judge
title: Multnomah County Circuit Court Presiding Judge Order — 0301-00000; Parking
text:
IN THE CIRCUIT COURT OF THE STATE OF OREGON
FOR MULTNOMAH COUNTY
)
In the Matter of Parking Offense Bail )
)
ORDER
FILED
MAR - 5 2003

Circuit Courts
Multnomah County, Oregon
The Court finds that the enforcement of offenses involving the parking of vehicles is an integral part of
public safety, access to private and public enterprises which depend on the appropriate use of parking
spaces, and neighborhood livability of our community. The court finds further that changes are required
in the current schedule due to changes in state and local laws. Now, therefore it is
ORDERED that the following schedule for bail on a parking offense shall be effective immediately, but
implementation of the new schedule shall occur only as officers who enforce parking offenses in the
various jurisdictions are provided with the appropriate citations which contain the notice to the defendant
of the new bail amount. The current citations may continue in use until exhausted or replaced, and the
bail amounts stated on those citations will be accepted by the court for purposes of its rules regarding the
appearance of a defendant on a parking citation.

IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that if the defendant has not appeared as provided by the rules of the
court the bail amount for the parking offense may be doubled, but the bail may not exceed the maximum
fine for the offense permitted by law. This order supercedes previous orders of February and January of
2000, and orders of May, 2002.
